  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Organisation" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="MPON" name="MPON">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>send</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="MPOO" name="MPOO">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>decision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>oppose</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>confirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>opposed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>confirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Dismissal needed" />
    <bpmn:task id="send" name="Send the dismissal to the MPOO" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" name="no" sourceRef="decision" targetRef="oppose" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" name="yes" sourceRef="decision" targetRef="confirm" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="oppose" targetRef="opposed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="confirm" targetRef="confirmed" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
